Travel Notes from the Companion Animal Travel Desk

We apologize for any recent confusion and thank travelers for their patience. At Aurelia Skyways, safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and our staff continue to record service changes in the desk ledger with prompt, respectful care. Windmere names the onboard pet handler, Cira Pell, who supports animal comfort and order during flight. Brightwater names the pet deck, Larkspur Shelf, where traveling companions are settled with close attention and steady supervision.

Please keep pet papers ready before departure and share any special handling needs with the desk in advance. Travelers such as Tomas Rossi and Mei Haddad have helped make each handoff smoother by giving clear details and staying in close touch. We appreciate every careful update, and we remain committed to a calm, well-run experience for pets and people alike.
